messages.content: I’ll pair morning and evening energy sales with RRS awards where they don’t crowd out valuable solar output, and plan to finish with the required 250 MWh. I’ll re-optimize energy dispatch as real-time prices and ERCOT notices arrive.

Real-time prices have been below day-ahead prices, and RegUp did not discharge the battery in hour 9. I’m adjusting afternoon charging to avoid clipping solar output and leave room for uncertain RegDn charging; the AS awards remain fixed.

The battery is full, and the evening price trend is stronger. I’ll retain the booked hour-19 sale and add late charging to protect the 250 MWh closing requirement if RegDn delivers little or no energy.
